prompt: A streamlined car with curved cabin roof and four separate wheels. The cabin rises over the body; four attached wheels occupy the left and right front and rear positions. Curved substantial surfaces carry their continuously attached functional parts. Overall width is 0.68 times depth; height is 0.69 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous near black, light blue, red color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
prompt_zh: 流线汽车有弧顶驾驶舱和四个分离车轮。驾驶舱位于车身上方，四轮分居左右前后并接车身。主体保持连续弧线轮廓，主要表面有实际厚度，功能部件按所属主体连接。。整体宽度约为前后长度的0.68倍，高度约为宽度的0.69倍，部件按功能位置围绕主体布置。。主体与附属部位采用近黑色、浅蓝色、红色的连续分区。正视显示主要功能部位，侧视显示前后厚度与连接，俯视显示横向布局和轮廓。。
